Three lists. That's the whole systemEvery job in Map My Maintenance lives on one of three lists. No tagging puzzles. No clever workflows to learn. Just three lists that match how the work actually gets done, and that talk to each other when they need to.
01
LIST 1 · WORK LIST
The jobs your team can handle in-houseManage day-to-day maintenance, repairs, and tasks using the skills your team already has. Every job includes everything needed to do it right, including photos, annotated instructions, the exact blueprint location, assignees, deadlines, and required parts. If a task requires a part to move forward, it links directly to the sourcing purchase order.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
What you can do with Map My MaintenanceFrom a single snag spotted in passing to a full refit scoped months in advance, here's what the system handles.
PIN TO PLAN
Every job, anchored to the place it livesDrop a pin from your phone the moment you spot something. The plan becomes the working map, fixes, projects, parts on order, all in the exact place they belong.
OCR
Snap the dataplate. Order the right partWe read the manufacturer and serial straight from the photo, and link them to the job that needs them.
ANNOTATE
Photos become work instructionsArrows, callouts, materials, method, straight on the photo.
STAGES
Every contractor, every stageInitiated → Progressing → Pending Review → Sent to Vendor. Always know where things stand.
HANDOVER
One-click handover reportsPDF or Excel with photos, signatures, and the full audit trail, branded as yours.

01
Upload your planDrop in a GA, a floor plan, or any layout drawing. Define the floors, decks, or levels. Draw the spaces within them. That's your map.
02
Invite your teamYour team, your contractors, your suppliers. Each one gets the right level of access, admin, normal, or guest, and lands in a workspace that's already set up for them.
03
Pin the work to the placeEvery job becomes a pin on the plan. A photo. A description. A priority. The person responsible. The date it's needed. Add a part to order and it links itself to the right list.
04
Track it from spotted to doneStatus changes notify the right team members automatically, and only when it matters. The job moves through its lifecycle. The map updates in real time. The audit trail writes itself.
